description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session server-side and returns { checkoutUrl, product, sessionId }. Hand the URL to the user; payment completes on Stripe's hosted page. This never charges. product: cottage_pro | county_packet | label_calc_pack | certified_exam. county_packet is county-specific (state + county required); label_calc_pack needs state. permit_guide and unlimited_pass are retired — checkout returns an error pointing at Cottage Pro / the $9 kit / the $9 pack. Pass idempotencyKey so agent retries cannot double-create sessions.

email.description: Buyer email, prefilled at Stripe Checkout

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key; retries with the same key reuse the Stripe session

product.description: Purchasable product id from list_products. permit_guide and unlimited_pass are retired and cannot be checked out.

state.description: Required for county_packet (2-letter abbrev or slug)

name: start_checkout
title: Start Stripe Checkout
